items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: So the first time I saw him, he was up north appearing with the Brownskin Models up in San Francisco.

ctx.x: I'll tell you who -- it's a funny thing; I almost thought of it. As a matter of fact, that's how Callender Red Calendar came out here. Red Calendar came out here from the east with the show called the Brownskin Models, and he was married to one of the girls in the show. So the first time I saw him, he was up north appearing with the Brownskin Models up in San Francisco. You look that up on Red, and see if he tells that.
Okay. When you got out here, what did your father do? Did he have a band out here? Or did he play in a band out here?
